claims: replay() of a literature-reading-run/2 folder makes no producer or reviewer call and returns the run's report, or refuses with ExampleError or ArtifactError.

Any changed byte in a caller run's files, any changed input, or any manifest setting above its ceiling refuses; only a consistently rewritten folder replays, and not when expected_evidence_sha256 names another run.
Every file of a caller run is read under the retained-file cap the run recorded, and every file a completed run writes can be read back under it.
A malformed manifest refuses before any run file other than run.json is read.
Replay of a packaged run, test_ld3, test_ld4 and test_ld5 are unchanged.

Every regular expression, string split, slice and special-case branch this change adds handles the whole class of input it is given, not only the examples in the tests and fixtures, and none reads structured text that a parser or an existing reader in this repository already reads.
